profile.name: Jack Nguyen
profile.headline: Analytics-driven product builder
profile.availability: Open to Product & Data Analyst roles
profile.summary: Analytics-driven product builder working across user research, product delivery, and data analysis, including helping build a learning product that reached 7,500+ users as of July 26, 2026.
profile.why_product_data: As a co-founder and analyst, I keep gravitating toward the same loop, talk to users, find the evidence that matters, ship a focused solution, and measure what changed. I want to bring that builder's instinct and analytical discipline to a product or data team at scale.
profile.builder_quote: I am most energized by turning a messy user or workflow problem into a clear decision, a shipped solution, and a measurable learning loop.

experiences.title: Co-Founder
experiences.description: Leads product discovery, analytics, workflow design, and AI-enabled prototyping for a learning product.

experiences.title: ERP Analyst I

projects.title: Thinkfy (formerly DebateLab)
projects.description: Debate-practice product with speech transcription, AI scoring across 12 categories, Vietnamese localization, and about 1,000 users as of July 26, 2026.

projects.title: Lumist Growth Analytics
projects.description: Grouped 151 free-text acquisition labels into seven channels across 5,500 students and compared 5.4% versus 33% conversion patterns to identify growth opportunities.

projects.title: E-Commerce Customer Analytics
projects.description: Analyzed 1.07M UK Online Retail II rows with SQL RFM and cohort methods, identifying a Champion segment representing 25% of customers and 69% of dataset revenue.

projects.title: Vendor and Accounts Payable Analytics
projects.description: Used advanced SQL and BI tools on a synthetic two-entity ERP ledger to surface spend concentration, never-paid vendors, and cross-entity exception patterns.

projects.title: Public Revenue Forecasting Reconstruction
projects.description: Built a public forecasting workflow on synthetic data using gradient boosting and walk-forward validation, reducing MAPE from approximately 22% to 4.5%.
